title: Social Media Marketing: Design & Plan
overview: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of both fundamental concepts and advanced techniques in social media marketing. It caters to participants with or without prior experience in the field. The course covers key platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and focuses on campaign development, lead generation, and performance analytics for each platform.
audience: This course is ideal for digital marketers, sales professionals, marketing and media specialists, webmasters, web developers, managers, and other professionals, regardless of prior social media marketing experience.
methodology: The course is designed to be highly interactive, incorporating group exercises, case studies, and video tutorials as part of the learning experience.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Recognize the value and advantages of using social media for business growth
Implement effective social media marketing strategies
Master best practices in content creation, scheduling, and reporting across various social media channels
Design and manage successful campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and other key platforms
Apply the rules of engagement to build and sustain an active online community
Utilize social media analytics to track and enhance campaign performance
